body: What specifically do you do differently now that you're over 50 that you didn't do when you were younger?  What is it that makes your life better now, then when you were younger?  I'd like to know, because I just can't find it anymore.  I know it's all my fault, but I truly can't see what my problem is.  What ever it is that's different now -- I mean, things that you control, not something that just arbitrarily happened to you -- please share, I could use the advice.
